title: Seal reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='28' y='62' width='44' height='30' rx='3' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='20' height='26' rx='2' fill='#f9e79f'/>
  <rect x='50' y='64' width='20' height='26' rx='2' fill='#fdf2d0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Flippers holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#5d6d8a' transform='rotate(15,30,72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='72' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#5d6d8a' transform='rotate(-15,70,72)'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#7a8fa8'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#a8c4d8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#8aa0b8'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='1.5' fill='#c8d8e8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='29' r='1.5' fill='#c8d8e8'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#b8ccdc'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a4a5a'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='35' y1='40' x2='42' y2='42' stroke='#d8e8f4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='44' x2='42' y2='44' stroke='#d8e8f4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='40' x2='58' y2='42' stroke='#d8e8f4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='44' x2='58' y2='44' stroke='#d8e8f4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d='M46 44 Q50 47 54 44' fill='none' stroke='#d8e8f4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Ear spots -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='3' fill='#6a8098'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='3' fill='#6a8098'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='68' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#6a8098' transform='rotate(-20,74,68)'/>
</svg>
